approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Exact identifiers with alphabetic discipline or project prefixes currently normalize to null even when they contain a digit.
RFI ARC-0042, Submittal MEP-023 and matching filenames therefore lose deterministic workflow relationships.
Extend the existing bounded normalizer only; keep digit requirements, email-address rejection, exact matching and distinct prefixes.
TXT question and Email response fixtures link as ARC-0042 while MEP-0042 remains distinct; 608 Python tests and all specification, manifest and JavaScript checks passed.
title: Preserve prefixed RFI and Submittal identifiers
objective: Preserve exact digit-bearing RFI and Submittal identifiers with alphabetic project or discipline prefixes across body, filename and workflow indexing without fuzzy matching.
